network.precision: binary64 arithmetic; one final IEEE754 binary32 conversion
network.scaling: NONE; any future fitted transform requires separate training-only binding

source_input_fields.event_id: nonempty bounded reference, unique within window
source_input_fields.interface_id: 64 lowercase SHA256 characters; declaration, not attestation
source_input_fields.timestamp_ns: integer 0..2^63-1; real capture requires kernel timestamp binding
source_input_fields.source_address/destination_address: canonical IP strings of same family
source_input_fields.ip_length: full IP bytes, 20..65535; transport minimum enforced

network.normalization: canonical IP addresses; IP total lengths; no packet payload
network.timeout_policy: reject interval >= idle or span >= active; caller segments first
network.length_statistics: population statistics over IP lengths in both directions
network.iat: consecutive ordered packet times in seconds; singleton IAT=0 by definition
network.loss_policy: GAPPED rejected; UNKNOWN allowed only as experimental diagnostic

dns.precision: binary64 arithmetic; one final IEEE754 binary32 conversion
dns.scaling: NONE; any future fitted transform requires separate training-only binding

source_input_fields.fqdn: ASCII string 1..254 characters including optional root dot

dns.normalization: ASCII lowercase; remove exactly one terminal dot; no trimming
dns.limits: 253 characters excluding terminal root; empty/root-only rejected
dns.character_population: concatenated labels, excluding dots; no public suffix inference
dns.special: hyphen and underscore divided by character population length
dns.entropy: Shannon log2 over lowercase character population
dns.idna: Punycode ASCII accepted literally; Unicode rejected, no IDNA conversion
dns.query_type: EXCLUDED; no training query-type dataset available
dns.encrypted_dns: unobservable; no derivation from DoH/DoT or name digests
